'''2007 Massachusetts State Championship Scott Lingrell DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2007 Massachusetts State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Scott Lingell
* '''Deck name:''' Combat - Dark
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
